settings.topline_text: Bridal · Party · Festive Mehendi   |   Aurangabad & Surrounding Areas
settings.hero_subtitle: Intricate bridal, Arabic and festive mehendi, thoughtfully designed for your special moments. Alfiya brings detail, elegance and a personal touch to every design across Aurangabad.
settings.about_paragraph_1: Bridal and party mehendi artist based in Aurangabad, Maharashtra. With a passion for fine detailing and traditional artistry, Alfiya creates bespoke henna designs that complement your celebration and personal style.
settings.about_paragraph_2: Whether you have a favourite inspiration reference or want a custom design crafted around your bridal outfit and occasion, let’s plan something beautiful together.
settings.contact_note: Citywide availability in Aurangabad · Enquire for outstation travel
